details.note: Every WBS has a branch for running the project itself: planning, money, permissions and people.
A work package: small enough to estimate and cost, with one owner and a clear finish.

name: Work breakdown structure
note: Break the project into deliverables, then each deliverable into work packages small enough to estimate and give to one owner. Number them so everyone can refer to them, and keep to nouns: what gets delivered, not when.
